patch.value: GH-741: replace reference-identity service override claiming with an explicit observable contract

GitHub: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/741. A registered service override that returns ctx.payload executes but is silently treated as unhandled because claim intent is inferred from object reference identity. Define an explicit handled/declined contract or at minimum an actionable warning, align testing/runtime behavior, and repair the first-party starter example.

Service override claim intent is explicit and type-safe rather than inferred from reference identity; same-reference pass-through, shallow-copy pass-through, modified results, and explicit decline have documented deterministic outcomes; runtime and SDK testing helpers return matching handled/result/warning envelopes; the first-party starter no longer demonstrates a silent no-op; focused and packed extension-author acceptance passes.
Extension service overrides cannot silently discard a handler result
